blocks.rationale: Jointly revise the installed exception producer and terminal consumer to consume the measured literal clause bundle. The producer derives the current source’s prohibition and qualified recipient permission from complete clause strings; the consumer then preserves the express-permission result while distinguishing an expressly queried generic third-party disclosure from an employee-specific statement unsupported by any express employee permission. This fixes the trigger’s nda-5 failure while preserving both history parents and leaves nda-16/nda-20 to ordinary fallback.

skill.intent: Determine from the current agreement’s literal nondisclosure clauses whether a disclosure query falls within an express, qualified recipient permission, and whether the agreement states a general third-party nondisclosure rule.

fields.name: nondisclosure_clauses
fields.question: Select the literal nondisclosure obligations and any expressly stated disclosure permissions/exceptions, preserving their attached qualifications and references. Select a governing clause even when it does not name Representatives. Do not select unrelated protected-information lists or notification duties as permissions.

fields.name: party_and_recipient_definitions
fields.question: Select literal source definitions identifying the parties/roles and recipient groups used by the nondisclosure clauses. Definitions may be embedded in the operative clause. Select text, not a legal role-equivalence conclusion or an invented list. Use unknown if no relevant defining text can be located.

reads.question: Locate the source text governing confidentiality/nondisclosure, its express disclosure permissions or exceptions, and the definitions needed to interpret those clauses. Select source spans only; do not decide any native hypothesis.
reads.source_locator: Complete supplied current source, including operative clauses, attached qualifications and definitions.

source_obligations.statement: Treat an express qualified recipient permission as entailing the queried disclosure; otherwise apply an affirmative third-party prohibition to a query expressly framed as disclosure to third parties, without manufacturing an employee-specific prohibition from an unexpanded generic class.
